responses.value: Invest in a pressing line. Plants have 6-month waitlists for new orders and vinyl sales have grown 10% a year for five years, and a $1.5M line earns about $1.2M a year ($1.20 on each of 1 million records), so it pays back in about 15 months. The main risk is that three new plants added 15% to industry capacity last year, which could shorten the waitlists. The next step is to sign pressing contracts with labels before buying.
Update. With 40% more capacity coming, the 6-month waitlists will go, so I'd wait before investing.
